about_the_game:
SET IN THE WORLD OF GREMLINS, INC.


The game is set in the world of corrupt capitalist gremlins of the future, the setting that's already familiar to the tabletop community from the digital board game Gremlins, Inc..

BUILD PROJECTS WHILE ATTACKING OTHERS AND DEFENDING YOUR OWN ACHIEVEMENTS


Build projects, play action cards and camouflage your plans from the opponents while preparing your attacks.

SINGLE-PLAYER AND MULTIPLAYER MODES


Single-player, multiplayer and ranked sessions. Adjustable decks.

PROVEN BY REAL-LIFE SESSIONS


Before we set to make it into a digital game, this game existed as a real-life card game.

A VIBRANT COMMUNITY AND A PUBLIC ROADMAP


We'll release this card game under the Early Access program as we'll be expanding and modifying it for quite some time. There are features which we were unable to implement in Gremlins, Inc., but which we can bring into the Card Game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: XP
  • Processor: Intel Pentium
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Internal

Recommended:

  • OS: 7, 8, 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 3+ generation

short_description: A digital card game set in the world of Gremlins, Inc., with intense sessions that last 15-45 minutes. Single-player, multiplayer and ranked sessions; modding support in the plans.
